title: Decoded pair of input words
statement: For a finite bit string $x$, let $t$ be the length of its initial run of $1$s. Decode the suffix of $x$ after its first $t+2$ bits using the aligned pair parser; if parsing is undefined, assign the pair of empty words.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a finite bit string
